{{Quote|Droid reinforcements have just arrived. We shall break into three groups to divide their defenses. I'll take the left flank. Skywalker, attack the front gate, Ahsoka, you scale the back wall, we'll meet in the middle.|Plo Koon|audio=SecondBattleofFelucia1.flac|<ref name="Padawan Lost" />}}
The '''Second Battle of Felucia''' saw a clash between [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] for control of the [[planet]] [[Felucia]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. Having been forced into a retreat at the [[First Battle of Felucia]], the Republic re-established a presence there thanks to the efforts of [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano]], who led their [[clone trooper]]s on an offensive into Separatist-held territory. In retaliation, [[General]] [[Grievous]] supplied [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)|one of his outposts]] on Felucia with reinforcements to secure the [[Felucia system|system]] for the Confederacy. Responding to the arrival of the [[battle droid]] detachment, Skywalker, Tano, and [[Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon]] targeted the enemy outpost with a three-pronged assault, each leading a [[squad]] to divide the Separatist defenses.<ref name="Padawan Lost" />

[[Clone trooper pilot]] [[Slider (clone pilot)|Slider]] flew a [[Clone Z-95 starfighter|Clone Z-95 Headhunter]] during the battle.<ref name="X-wing Twitter" /> Supported by heavy [[artillery]] [[tank]]s situated on an adjacent ridge, the [[Jedi]] and [[Cloning|clones]] were able to secure the base from [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid]] [[TZ-33]], eliminating all of the [[droid]] forces there. However, Tano was captured during the fighting by a [[Garnac's hunting guild|group]] of [[Trandoshan]] [[Hunting|hunters]], who brought her to the [[moon]] [[Wasskah]] to be [[Battle on Wasskah|hunted]] for sport. Skywalker and Koon withdrew from Felucia the following [[Standard day|day]] after failing to locate the missing Padawan.<ref name="Padawan Lost" />

The Republic's victory brought Felucia and its surrounding region under its control. However, Felucia would later find itself back into the fold of the Clone Wars<ref name="BTCTG" /> and was the site of a stronghold for the Separatists.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> All the same, the native [[Felucian]]s still did not side with the CIS.<ref name="BTCTG" /> Jedi General [[Aayla Secura]] led an [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)|assault on Felucia]] during the final days of the Clone Wars.<ref name="Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>
